aspect: Verification as standard, at the applicant's cost
description: Transcripts and certificates are sent to third-party evaluators and to the issuing institution. The fee and the wait are the applicant's, and an unanswered verification is treated as a failure.
energy_note: Genuine, and checked anyway, at your expense.

description: A four-year Nigerian degree may be assessed as equivalent to less than a bachelor's in some systems, requiring a bridging year before postgraduate entry.
energy_note: Four years of study, assessed as three.

aspect: Professional requalification is the real cost
description: Doctors, nurses, engineers, lawyers and accountants re-sit examinations, complete supervised practice and pay for both while working below their level.

aspect: HONEST GAP - the strike-gap suspicion is not documented
description: No sourced evidence was found that credential evaluators specifically flagged 2022-2023 Nigerian transcripts as suspicious because of the irregular date gaps created by the ASUU strike. The concern is widely expressed in Nigerian commentary and is recorded here as unverified.
energy_note: Plausible, widely feared, and not demonstrated.

description: Her four-year Nigerian bachelor's is evaluated abroad as equivalent to three years of study. The master's she was admitted to requires a full bachelor's equivalent, so she is offered a bridging year at GBP 14,000 that teaches her material she covered in her second year.
energy_note: A year and fourteen thousand pounds, to re-learn her second year.
